messages.content: You maintain a short summary of what a support desk's messages establish about delivery as of 2026-10-09. A later message replaces what an earlier message said. Copy every id, amount, date, and name exactly as the messages write it. Write only the summary, in at most three sentences.

(2026-10-08) user: For anything stuck at a carrier depot, Tomasz Brennan in the warehouse issues the release.
(2026-10-08) user: Tomasz Brennan: He's off tomorrow, Friday 2026-10-09, so release requests have to reach him today.
(2026-10-08) user: Ugh, the label printer by the door just jammed again and ate half a roll of shipping labels.
(2026-10-08) user: Quick one before the queue: Kenji Nakamura's replacement kettle on order LH-81660 needs a gift note that reads 'Happy 40th, Aiko'.
(2026-10-08) user: First real ticket: Grace Okafor on account LH-20418 says order LH-77302 never arrived, and she wants a replacement.
(2026-10-08) user: Anyway, can you check where the Halvorsen shipment actually is?
(2026-10-08) user: Parcelway logged the locker trace on Grace Okafor's missing duvet as TR-3307.
(2026-10-08) user: They say they'll answer within a day.
